title: A certified time-expanded set-partitioning algorithm tightening the reported optimality gap for the two-echelon multi-trip vehicle routing problem with satellite synchronization
description: Replication package for the paper "A certified time-expanded set-partitioning algorithm tightening the reported optimality gap for the two-echelon multi-trip vehicle routing problem with satellite synchronization" (Chouchena and Ben-Abu). It contains the bounding procedure (a time-expanded set-partitioning reformulation of the street echelon solved by column generation with an exact pricing routine, composed with the water-echelon bound of the originating study), the primal pipeline, an independent joint verifier, versioned per-instance certificates and decoded solutions, and the scripts that regenerate every reported table and figure. The predecessors' (Karademir, Beirigo and Atasoy, 2025) unlicensed instance generator and model are NOT redistributed; they are fetched and sha256-verified on demand (see THIRD_PARTY.md). code_hash, not git_sha, is the reproducibility anchor.
